titulo_ja: おわり の はなし (2)

にかけては.es: en cuanto a (lo que se refiere a)

へて.es: (forma て de へる) pasando por

bloques.titulo: In the case of the United Kingdom, the Commission has not submitted any comments on the situation in the Member States.
texto: A competition or an area in which someone stands out: noun + **にかけては**. You can talk about yourself or another person; the tone depends on the context: **にほんご にかけては、 だれ に も まけない** (in Japanese, there is no one who wins me).
To say that something comes to an end after going through several stages: substantive + **を へて**: **いくつ か の だんかい を へて、 かんせい しました** (after several stages, it was completed).
It is formal and used in history and processes.
